name: Adam Bielan - Après le considérant Y - Am 5
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the changing geopolitical situation in East Asia and the need for closer cooperation with like-minded partners in the region
part_text: A. whereas East Asia and the broader Indo-Pacific are pivotal to global prosperity and security, hosting vital sea lanes, advanced technology ecosystems, major trade routes, over half the world’s population, and critical supply chains essential to EU economic competitiveness, export performance and long-term industrial resilience, including in strategic sectors such as semiconductor production, digital technology and advanced manufacturing; whereas it is also a region accounting for a substantial and growing share of EU external trade and investment flows;
